target: Observed LTFJ ceiling strictly below 500 ft AGL within (t, t+3h]
selection_metric: 2024 Brier score (all models without class balancing)
calibration: Intercept-only probability adjustment on 2024; also retain raw probabilities
alarm_rule: On 2024 choose highest precision threshold attaining at least 70 percent origin recall; exploratory
guardrails: Do not tune to 2025 or 2026 outcomes.
2025 was already inspected for data quality; it is not an untouched final test.
No receipt timestamps; observation availability remains assumed.
Report Brier, PR-AUC, calibration, false alarms and event-level detection.
No deployment or operational validity claim from retrospective evaluation.
